draft_en.subject: Second ODM source for the industrial PoE switches in the LTV range
draft_en.body:
Hello LTV team,

For the industrial PoE switches in the LTV range, we can be a second ODM source in LTV packaging from small lots, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed (VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the unmanaged version - STI-288GP - $62.2; 4 x PoE+ + 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP - STI-154GP - $40.8. SFP modules we do not supply; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which industrial SKU do your installers order most - 4-port or 8-port?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
